**Fraser Lee Campbell** is a British Hot Wheels designer who worked at Mattel from 1998 to 2016 and again since 2021. Initially based in the UK, Fraser moved to the United States in 2000 to join the Hot Wheels design team; his first design was [Maelstrom](/wiki/Maelstrom). He would move to Hong Kong at some point later before moving back to the United States; much of his work during his time at Mattel involved designing for [Monster Jam](/wiki/Monster_Jam) and various haulers for [Truckin' Transporters](/wiki/Truckin%27_Transporters), [Pavement Pounders](/wiki/Pavement_Pounders) and related lines as well as some of the bikes in the [Street Power](/wiki/Street_Power) line. Campbell left Mattel in early 2016 to join Hackrod, an automotive design company started by ex-Mattel and Hot Wheels VP of Design [Felix Holst](/wiki/Felix_Holst). He left Hackrod in mid-2020 and returned to Mattel in 2021 as Lead Project designer for Basics/Mainline.

## Other[]

Over the years, Fraser has worked on many of the Haulers and [Truckin' Transporters](/wiki/Truckin%27_Transporters) for the Hot Wheels line. He brings a wide variety of designs to these trucks from exotic futuristic rigs to modern ones that could easily hit today's highways. He has also worked on the larger-scale Hot Wheels motorcycles like the Twin Flame and Ferenzo.

## [Monster Jam](/wiki/Monster_Jam)[]

The [Monster Jam](/wiki/Monster_Jam) line is where Fraser has done a lot of his work. Many of the monster trucks have been designed or shrunk to small scale by him. So far the [Monster Jam](/wiki/Monster_Jam) trucks have been a smashing hit In fact, the Batman, Superman, TMNT, Spiderman, Wolverine and Taz were all designed small first and then made into real trucks for Monster Jam and more recently the Tiger Shark and Mega Wrex for Hot Wheel Monster Truck events.
Some of his works include:
